decision: The replayed seven-coordinate action is work-conjugate, but the saved ASCII FRD precision bound exceeds the apparent seam imbalance. Stop interpreting this S4 residual as a native connection defect. No L1 multiplier space or physical law is selected; G0B/F03 remain open.
limitations: The print bound covers displacement formatting in the replayed linear operator. It does not bound the S4-to-solid operator difference or prove the original S4 sided force exactly.
The welded S4 seam, deformable web and two-force torque loading differ from the native L1/B3 material-pose law and applied rotational moment.
